name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.ofFn_extend_getD
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) {A : Type}
  (I :
    DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation (Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.m γ))
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ) A)
  (a : Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.k γ) → A) (d : A) (i : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (List.getD.{0} (List.ofFn.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.extend γ I a d)) i d)
    (List.getD.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.evalNodes γ I a d) i d)

source.code:
theorem ofFn_extend_getD (I : Interpretation (Fin γ.m) γ.arity A) (a : Fin γ.k → A) (d : A)
    (i : ℕ) : (List.ofFn (γ.extend I a d)).getD i d = (γ.evalNodes I a d).getD i d := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i γ.nodes.length with h | h
  · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using h), List.getElem_ofFn]
    rfl
  · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by simpa using h),
      List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by rw [evalNodes_length]; exact h)]
